concept: Standing by a friend even when it's not the popular choice
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short scenario where a character's friend is left out of a group, and the character must choose whether to include them
exercise.reflection_prompt: What made this a hard choice for the character?
exercise.practice: Student describes a time they included someone or wishes they had

assessment.success_marker: student connects the story to a real or imagined situation in their own words
